record.question: What does the term 'pitch' refer to in helical CT scanning?
options: The speed of the X-ray tube rotation.
The angle of the gantry tilt.
The relationship between the table movement and the X-ray beam width during a helical acquisition.
The number of detectors in a row.
record.explanation: Answer C: The relationship between the table movement and the X-ray beam width during a helical acquisition.. Helical CT pitch is table travel per rotation relative to total collimated beam width. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct; https://www.acr.org/Clinical-Resources/Clinical-Tools-and-Reference/Contrast-Manual. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
